answer: Ephemeral pulse sampling. Each identity must answer randomized liveness challenges during unpredictable windows; missing one voids its reputation and releases its escrow to challengers. The sampling rate scales with account age, so clones must sustain activity across a scattered karst of timing windows they cannot predict. An attacker’s marginal cost is continuous attention plus escrow exposure per clone, exceeding any walnut-sized expected gain from one extra identity.
